# V07 teardown — "$282,000 generated by editors from one secret program" (Ultimate Editors 2.0 offer)
720x1280 @30fps, 1452 frames (#0-#1451, 48.4 s). Coordinates x%/y% and px in 1080x1920 (= src x1.5). Frame #N = N/30 s. ms = (end_f − start_f)·1000/30. Q3 fit gate, Q5 sheet timings "~", Q10 no sound named as fact, Q18 on-screen text over ASR.

## 1. Overview
- Hook: "$282,000 is how much editors have generated in the last nine months from this one secret program. Want to know what it is?" (0-8 s). Offer video: what the program teaches (4 styles), 60-day beginner result, "$2,000 per month editor blueprint", the name "Ultimate Editors 2.0", closing in 2 weeks, price now $299, CTA comment "Ultimate Editors" (45.5-48.4 s). [OBS]
- Structure: HOOK #0-218 (0-7.3 s: counter, tweets, "in one secret program") → PROMISE #219-571 (7.3-19.1 s: "Master the viral editing styles of 2026", 4 category cards) → PROOF #572-1028 (19.1-34.3 s: beginner→60 days, $2,000/mo blueprint card, personal-brand UI, profiles) → OFFER #1029-1380 (34.3-46 s: program banner, closing forever, price card, tweets) → CTA #1381-1451 (46-48.4 s). [OBS]
- Runtime share [EST from cut list + sheets]: full A-roll with small overlays ≈ 22 s (45%); blue-ground full-frame graphics ≈ 14 s (29%); split screen (blue pane top / A-roll bottom) ≈ 12.4 s (26%).
- Shots: 4 hard cuts (#192, #219, #572, #1029; diffs 91-121) + 5 pane slide/blur transitions; avg hard-cut shot 9.68 s over 5 shots; visual state changes ≈ every 2.3 s [EST].
- Distinct animations catalogued: 18 (V07-A01…A18); 6 usable curves (see §12).
- Look: dark blue-tee A-roll (ribbed wall, no heavy grade), blue ground (#204F98 → #447BBD, rays + grid), white UI cards, thin white captions with italic-serif script words, one green accent for money (#282,000 glow, $299), a hand-drawn red ellipse once.

**V07-A01 Money counter count-up** — large bold white numerals (≈ 5% H cap, centred at y≈ 74% of the first strip tile → y≈ 65% H) with a soft blur-behind; values read from 2 fps tiles: 0.0 s $88,011 · 0.5 s $233,838 · 1.0 s $276,423 · 1.5 s $281,963 · 2.0 s $282,000 [OBS values, ~]. Progress p(t)=v/282000: 0.31, 0.83, 0.98, 0.9998, 1 → monotone ease-out (≈ easeOutExpo-like) over ≈ 2.0 s; at the end numerals turn green with a bloom glow (≈ #4CE38B [EST]) and the caption starts. Trigger "282,000"@#0 (Δ0; the counter is already running at #0). Rebuild: requestAnimationFrame lerp with `1−2^(−10t)`, toLocaleString, text-shadow 0 0 18px green.

## 4. Text & typography system
| style | font (conf.) | weight | cap %H | colour | use |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Counter | grotesque (SF/Inter-like, med) | Bold | ≈5 | #FFFFFF → green ≈ #4CE38B [EST] | $282,000 |
| A-roll caption | grotesque | Regular/Bold on key word | ≈1.5-1.8 | #FFFFFF | spoken lines |
| Script word | italic high-contrast serif (low-med) | Regular italic | ≈2 | #FFFFFF | Editors, secret, Beginner, Ever, forever, Blueprint, viral |
| Card title | grotesque | Bold | ≈1.5 | #FFFFFF on black | "$2,000/mo Editor Blueprint" |
| Price numerals | grotesque | Bold | ≈2.8 | #222 → green #2FD26B [EST] | $1,200 → $299 |
| UI micro text | SF-like | Regular | 0.4-0.7 | grey | tweets, profile cards |
Rules [INF]: script on the noun/adverb that carries the claim; bold on action words; money = large bold numerals + green when "good"; captions on blue at the top (y≈ 6-12% H), on A-roll at y≈ 62% H.

## 10. Editing psychology
| condition | action | reason [INF] |
|---|---|---|
| a result claim (money) | giant counting numerals on the speaker, then message screenshots | number + proof within 4 s of hook |
| the hidden thing ("secret program") | locked, pixelated card on blue | curiosity gap; reveal later (34 s) |
| features list (4 styles) | one category card per feature, each with live sample reel | the product is visible, one feature at a time |
| the claim about results | A-roll with plain captions, then profile cards | speaker credibility, then evidence |
| the offer + price | name banner → "closing forever" with hand-drawn circle → price count-down to $299 (green) | urgency + relief |
| CTA | comment bar types the keyword | one action |
Pacing (state changes per 10 s [EST from §2 + A-lists]): 0-10 s: 12 · 10-20 s: 8 · 20-30 s: 7 · 30-40 s: 9 · 40-48.4 s: 8. Hook densest; the middle (20-30 s) is calmest because the claims are carried by the speaker.

## 11. Signature moves (self-contained recipes)
1. Count-up money numerals: ease-out to $282,000 in 2.0 s, then green glow.
2. Pane-slide split screen: blue top pane 50% H in 1.3-1.5 s (`cubic-bezier(.4,.6,0,.9)`), reused 4× as the recurring "evidence" device.
3. Locked, pixelated thumbnail = "secret program".
4. Category carousel: sample reel above + title card below, blur-slide every ≈ 1.8 s, with "next" button and cursor.
5. Price card count-down ($1,200 → $1,116 → $463 → $299, ≈ 0.5 s per step) with green final + strike of the old price.
6. Hand-drawn red ellipse around the urgency word (≈ 0.4 s draw).
7. Stacked tweet/email cards rising from the bottom edge (1.27 s `cubic-bezier(.2,.3,0,1)`) as proof layer.
8. Script on the noun / bold on the verb caption rule.
